O.outcome_detail: power and precision for OLS mediator-achievement associations

result.effect: about 150 to 200 schools required for precise OLS estimates

cells.quote: The power analysis finds that for currently available mediators, the OLS approach will yield precise estimates of associations between teacher practice measures and student test score gains only if the sample contains about 150 to 200 study schools.
cells.note: The report's conclusion contrasts this requirement with typical RCTs; the foreword states that typical designs have 60 schools and limited power.

O.outcome_detail: Provision of differentiated tutoring, counseling, and enrichment opportunities

cells.quote: The school staff work together to monitor progress towards goals throughout the year. They regularly meet in grade-level and vertical-planning teams to examine data and to discuss whether or not movement has been made towards the goals they set at the beginning of the year. Principal Walker helps teachers at Ivy break down the data by student, classroom, and grade level, and evaluate whether or not the students are making progress. If students are not making progress, they all talk about what could be done to address the situation. For example, the staff identified different tiers of support for student groups. The school has a range of tutoring and other learning opportunities for students who need extra supports; individualized counseling for students with attendance issues; and extra weekend and tutoring programs to challenge top-level students.
cells.note: The study describes monitoring and differentiated support practices but does not report a treatment-versus-comparison outcome or an effect on student achievement.

cells.quote: He notes that the school has a caring culture that is focused on supporting and nurturing students, where teachers get together to give each other advice about how to help students, not to complain about them.
